sections.title: Discounting
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Ambitious Impact's: its sheet counts a year of benefit the same whenever it comes. In our view later years count less at the shared discount rate (Your values); the evaluator view pins the rate at 0, so Ambitious Impact's numbers reproduce.

rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (treatment, counselling, coaching, outreach): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Discount rate on future benefits
rows.explainer: The shared discount rate (Your values). Ambitious Impact doesn't discount in this sheet, so the evaluator view pins it at 0.

rows.label: Same rate, compounded continuously
Discount factor: permanent methods
rows.explainer: Benefits spread evenly over the years the effect lasts, starting now: their present value as a share of the undiscounted total.

rows.label: Discount factor: long-acting reversible methods
rows.explainer: Benefits spread evenly over the years the effect lasts, starting now: their present value as a share of the undiscounted total.

rows.label: Discount factor: short-term methods
rows.explainer: Benefits spread evenly over the years the effect lasts, starting now: their present value as a share of the undiscounted total.

rows.label: Discount factor, weighted by pregnancies averted per method
rows.explainer: Each method's pregnancies averted are spread over the years its protection lasts; the factors are weighted by how many pregnancies each method averts. Our approximation: Ambitious Impact's sheet counts all of them undiscounted.

rows.label: DALYs averted per dollar
rows.explainer: Times our discount factor for benefits spread over years. With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (over the charity's life)

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity adding family planning counselling and contraception to the care women get in the year after giving birth. The idea Maternal Health Initiative was founded to run. Its bottom line is the cost per DALY averted over the charity's life, counting health benefits of fewer unintended pregnancies (unsafe abortion, anaemia, obstructed labour, postpartum depression).
